dataset_name: OnlineUniversityGuide.in — Admission, Examination Pattern, Career Opportunities & Scholarship Criteria
research_reference: College Vidya university/course page architecture and current content patterns, supplemented with official university sources where available.

critical_policy.complete_coverage: Every one of the 14 universities and every programme in the master dataset has a record.
critical_policy.no_invention: Do not invent scholarship percentages, placement statistics, exam weightages, admission dates or programme-specific rules.
critical_policy.source_priority: Official current university source > current programme source > College Vidya reference > unresolved/pending.
critical_policy.pillar_vs_course: University pillar pages contain full university-level information. Course pages inherit only the relevant common facts and add course-specific career/admission/exam/scholarship overrides.
critical_policy.duplicate_content: Do not copy full university paragraphs into every course page. Reuse structured facts, summarize them in course context, and link to the university pillar page for the complete process.
critical_policy.missing_data: If a field has status not_safely_verified/reference_only, do not present it as an official numeric/current claim.
